newStatus.recovery: REQUIRED — RECOVERY_PACKET must be used for recovery operations
newStatus.nativeBuildPro: REQUIRED — must generate context packet at phase start, each agent start, recovery, and iteration boundary
newStatus.buildLite: OPTIONAL — Build Lite users may use context packets but are not required to
newStatus.nativeAgentStart: REQUIRED — AGENT_START_PACKET before each spawn_agent call
newStatus.longHorizon: REQUIRED — same as Native Build Pro plus per-iteration regeneration

rejectedOptions: Context Packet REQUIRED for all modes — rejected as overreach for Build Lite
Context Packet OPTIONAL for all modes — rejected as insufficient for Build Pro safety
rationale: PRO-2 evidence: 10 context packets used across 3 iterations — demonstrated value
Long-horizon analysis: context quality degrades without structured minimal packets
Build Pro agents need role-specific boundaries — context packets provide this
Recovery without context packet = agents restarting without knowing prior state
Build Lite remains simpler — overhead not justified for single-agent workflows
